name: Ahmed Shawky
title: Software Engineer | Full-Stack (Flutter & Java Spring Boot)

details: Studied OOP, Data Structures, Algorithms, Software Engineering, Database Systems, and Web Architecture.
Graduation Project: DR-FIT – Fitness & Health Mobile Application.
Developed cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter, Clean Architecture, REST APIs, and local databases.
Built multiple mobile applications with diverse designs, features, and real-world use cases using REST APIs and Firebase.
Collaborated in Agile team environments, enhancing problem-solving, communication, and delivery skills.

projects.title: DR-FIT – Fitness App (Graduation Project)
projects.description: A scalable fitness and health tracking mobile application. Features include authentication, user profiles, dynamic workout plans, and a nutrition system. Implemented community features like posts, comments, and reactions.

projects.title: Noor Quran – Islamic Mobile App
projects.description: An Islamic mobile application for Quran reading (QCF Mushaf), prayer times, Qibla, Adhkar, and Tafsir with native RTL multi-language support. Implemented location-based prayer calculations, compass-based Qibla, offline content, background audio playback, and local caching.

projects.title: E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce platform featuring Spring Boot REST APIs, a customer storefront, and an administrative dashboard. Implemented secure authentication with JWT refresh tokens, role-based access control (RBAC), product management, shopping cart, checkout, orders, and sales analytics.

projects.title: HR Management System
projects.description: An enterprise HR management system built for employee directory, department organization, and leave request management. Features JWT authentication, BCrypt password hashing, and automated deployment pipelines.

projects.title: Real-Time Chat Application
projects.description: A real-time messaging backend platform supporting bidirectional communication. Implemented secured REST APIs for authentication, dynamic conversations, instant messaging, and message read receipts.

projects.title: Tech News AI App
projects.description: A real-time news aggregation mobile application consuming external REST APIs. Features an AI-powered integrated chatbot for interactive Q&A and image descriptions.
